#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 300;
const int INF = 1e9;

struct edge{
    int to, rev, f, cap;
    edge(int to, int rev, int f, int cap) : to(to), rev(rev), f(f), cap(cap) {}
};
vector<edge> adj[MAXN];

void add_edge(int u, int v, int c, int rc = 0) {
    edge a(v, adj[v].size(), 0, c);
    edge b(u, adj[u].size(), 0, rc);
    adj[u].push_back(a);
    adj[v].push_back(b);
}

int dis[MAXN], ptr[MAXN], src, dst;

bool bfs() {
    memset(dis, -1, sizeof dis);
    dis[src] = 0;
    queue<int> q({src});
    while(q.size() && dis[dst] == -1) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for(auto e : adj[u]) {
            int v = e.to;
            if(dis[v]==-1 && e.f < e.cap) {
                dis[v] = dis[u] + 1;
                q.push(v);
            }
        }
    }
    return dis[dst] != -1;
}

int dfs(int u, int f) {
    if(u == dst || !f)
           return f;
    for(int &i = ptr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); i++){
        edge &e = adj[u][i];
        int v = e.to;
        if(dis[v] != dis[u] + 1)
                continue;
        if(int df = dfs(v, min(f, e.cap - e.f))) {
            e.f += df;
            adj[v][e.rev].f -= df;
            return df;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int mf() {
    int res = 0;
    while(bfs()) {
        memset(ptr, 0, sizeof ptr);
        while(int df = dfs(src, INF))
            res += df;
    }
    return res;
}

int dx[] = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
int dy[] = {0, -1, 1, 0};

int n, m;
typedef vector<vector<int>> grid;
typedef array<int, 2> pa;
grid obs, tim, dii;

void gbfs(int r, int c, grid &dis, bool chk = False) {
    for(int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        fill(dis[i].begin(), dis[i].end(), -1);
    dis[r][c] = 0;
    queue[pa] = deque(pa)
    q.append((r, c))
    while q.size() {
        p = q.popleft()
        if chk and dis[p[0]][p[1]] == tim[p[0]][p[1]]
        	continue
        for i in range(4):
            r = (p[0] + dx[i], p[1] + dy[i])
            if r[0] < 0 or r[0] >= n or r[1] < 0 or r[1] >= n or dis[r[0]][r[1]] != -1 or obs[r[0]][r[1]] 
                continue
            if chk and tim[r[0]][r[1]] > -1 and dis[p[0]][p[1]] + 1 > tim[r[0]][r[1]]
            	continue
            dis[r[0]][r[1]] = dis[p[0]][p[1]] + 1
            q.append(r)
    }
}

vector[string] lab, rea

int main() {
    cin >> n >> m
    lab.resize(n)
    rea.resize(n)
    for x in lab:
        cin >> x
    for x in rea:
        cin >> x
    obs.assign(n, vector[int](n))
    tim.assign(n, vector[int](n))
    dii.assign(n, vector[int](n))
    for i in range(n):
    	for j in range(n):
    		obs[i][j] = (lab[i][j] == 'Y')
    for i in range(n):
    	for j in range(n):
    		if lab[i][j] == 'Z'
    			gbfs(i, j, tim)
    src = 2*n*n + 5
    dst = src + 1
    for x in range(n):
    	for y in range(n):
    		if lab[x][y] == 'Z' or lab[x][y] == 'Y'
    			continue
    		add_edge(src, n*x + y, lab[x][y] - '0')
    		add_edge(n*n + n*x + y, dst, rea[x][y] - '0')
    		gbfs(x, y, dii, True)
    		for xp in range(n):
    			for yp in range(n):
    				if dii[xp][yp] != -1 and dii[xp][yp] <= m:
    					add_edge(n*x + y, n*n + n*xp + yp, INF)
    	}
    print(mf())

        self.f = f
        self.cap = cap

adj = [[] for _ in range(MAXN)]

def add_edge(u, v, c, rc=0):
    a = Edge(v, len(adj[v]), 0, c)
    b = Edge(u, len(adj[u]), 0, rc)
    adj[u].append(a)
    adj[v].append(b)

dis = [-1]*MAXN
ptr = [0]*MAXN
src = dst = 0

def bfs():
    global dis
    dis[src] = 0
    q = deque([src])
    while q and dis[dst] == -1:
        u = q.popleft()
        for e in adj[u]:
            v = e.to
            if dis[v] == -1 and e.f < e.cap:
                dis[v] = dis[u] + 1
                q.append(v)
    return dis[dst] != -1

def dfs(u, f):
    if u == dst or not f:
        return f
    for i in range(ptr[u], len(adj[u])):
        e = adj[u][i]
        v = e.to
        if dis[v] != dis[u] + 1:
            continue
        if (df := dfs(v, min(f, e.cap - e.f))):
            e.f += df
            adj[v][e.rev].f -= df
            return df
    return 0

def mf():
    res = 0
    while bfs():
        ptr = [0]*MAXN
        while (df := dfs(src, INF)):
            res += df
    return res

src = 2*n*n + 5
dst = src + 1
